item.title: Using body language to build trust and connection in early childhood settings
item.description: Positive communication in early childhood education is never just about the words educators use. It is also reflected in how they show children that they are safe, valued, heard and understood.

item.title: New funding strengthens Australia’s In Home Care system and supports families with complex needs
item.description: The Australian Government has highlighted a package of financial and workforce support for Australia’s In Home Care program, recognising its critical role for families unable to access other forms of early childhood education and care.

item.title: Inclusion Ready Toolkit launches to strengthen inclusive practice across ECEC
item.description: A new national toolkit is helping approved providers, service leaders and educators build their capability and confidence to create early childhood education and care environments where every child can participate, belong and thrive.

item.title: We can’t solve educator burnout by teaching exhausted educators to tolerate exhaustion
item.description: For years, conversations about educator wellbeing have often centred on what the individual educator can do differently. Practise mindfulness. Build resilience. Take breaks. Exercise. Eat well. Set boundaries. Find something that fills your cup. None of those things are inherently bad advice. In fact, many of them can be incredibly valuable.

item.title: 15 per cent pay rise for early educators locked in as new legislation passes parliament
item.description: The Australian Parliament has passed legislation extending funding for the 15 per cent wage increase for eligible early childhood education and care workers while introducing stronger safety conditions for participating services.
